data.narrative:
Nord Quantique is a seed-stage quantum computing company that has raised C$40M+ including a C$23M round from Quantum Champions in December 2025. The quantum computing sector comp universe includes 3 public peers (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private companies, among them Quantinuum, IonQ, D-Wave Quantum, Rigetti Computing, and Infleqtion.

The peer-median method proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow quantum computing peer set. Instead, stage-progression analysis anchored the valuation. Using the C$40M total capital raised as a baseline value proxy and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from seed to next stage yields an implied valuation of $100M.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to one applicable method, supports a valuation range of $85M to $115M, with a median of $100M. Key uncertainties include the limited comparability of the broader quantum computing sector given heterogeneous business models and development timelines, and the absence of recent arm's-length financing rounds at similar stages to validate the stage-progression multiplier. A future Series A or institutional financing event would provide critical data to narrow this range.
